name: Buzzsprout
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Buzzsprout, generate an RSS feed and organize episode files on user-owned hosting. The hard boundary is podcast hosting uptime, bandwidth, analytics, directory integrations, and support, plus audio infrastructure, distribution, and production polish.
